labels.status: EXECUTED model runs; numerics VERIFIED by tests/test_spray_flame.py (zero-liquid limit, monotonic trends); NOT experimentally VALIDATED.
labels.validity: Ballal-Lefebvre correlations fitted at 0.1-1 atm, ~300 K, quiescent mists, SMD ~20-200 um; applied here at 25-35 bar and 650-820 K (EXTRAPOLATED). Turbulence and spark-kernel efficiency not modelled.
labels.inputs_bias: Module 09 nominal over-predicts evaporation vs CFD (1.5-2.5x at A1); cfd_matched variant is a sensitivity bound. Module 09 wall-impinged liquid (58-97 %) is NOT in the charge here (film is Module 13's job).
labels.search_cap: a max-SMD value equal to 1000 um (D_MAX_SEARCH_m) means no limit was found up to 1 mm.
